stem:
Nupur has two identical jars. She pours oil into jar M up to a higher mark than into jar N. Volume means the space the oil occupies, not only each jar's full capacity.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Jar M holds a larger volume of oil because the oil occupies more space.
Both jars hold equal volumes of oil because they have the same capacity.
Jar N holds more oil because more empty space remains above its lower oil mark.
The volumes are equal whenever the jars have the same shape.

teacher.key_rationale: Volume is the space occupied by the oil. A higher mark means more volume in M. Matching capacity or shape does not force equal filled volumes, and empty space above the lower mark does not mean N holds more oil.
